name: Logo Magic
old_description: Logo Magic has been locally owned and operated since 1989 and specializes in custom FR and corporate apparel as well as promotional products to help grow your business. We also offer an e-commerce service for corporate apparel, benefits, school groups, athletic teams, reunions and more by creating and administrating custom online stores for your business or group.
about:
Logo Magic has been locally owned and operated in Dickinson, North Dakota since 1989. The company began as a provider of custom flame‑resistant and corporate apparel, later expanding into promotional products and online store management for businesses, schools, and groups.

The shop runs in‑house screen printing, embroidery, and laser etching equipment to produce decorated apparel such as FR gear, hats, shirts, jackets, and blankets, as well as a wide range of promotional items including bags, drinkware, and office accessories. A graphic design team prepares artwork for each order, and the company also builds and administers temporary e‑commerce storefronts for corporate uniform programs, fundraisers, and team stores. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers range from small businesses and large corporations to schools, clubs, athletic teams, and individuals. The company cites work for corporate uniform programs, fire‑department FR gear, school spirit wear, and personal projects such as family reunion shirts. Vendors supplying blank goods include SanMar, S&S Activewear, Augusta Sportswear, and Richardson Caps.

Logo Magic states its main goal is to deliver a quality product at a competitive price while guiding clients through every step from design to delivery. It emphasizes free custom art services with most apparel orders, quick turnarounds on embroidery and laser‑etched gifts with no minimum quantities, and a hands‑on approach that includes in‑person consultation and doorstep delivery.
